description: The jar is full of preserves, but the wax seal is still unbroken. It has a heavy, cool feel in the hand. I have kept it just as it was. It has been sitting on my desk for about a week, and it is still there, unchanged.
soul_link_note: Toby shelves every thank-you gift unopened and repays it in goods; this jar is one such gift, still sealed. The debt is his, not the job's, so the jar travels with the soul whatever role the reshuffle deals him.
